description: Hydranten - Gemeinde Schöneiche bei Berlin (WFS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal-schoeneiche-bei-berlin.de. The graphical representation of the locations of hydrants provides information on the central fire-fighting water supply within the municipality. In addition to the exact, spatial location, further factual information is maintained and the supply area is shown with a radius of 300m. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Hydranten - Municipality Schöneiche near Berlin (WFS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Hydranten, Löschwasserversorgung, Gemeinde Schöneiche bei Berlin, infoFeatureAccessService. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
